result.reason: The redline covers affiliates, adds contractors, and permits transfer in an M&A transaction, but it omits the required protections that paid-up licences be perpetual and irrevocable and that subscription licences be terminable only for uncured material breach. It also unnecessarily gives Garman a reciprocal right to assign in an M&A transaction, changing unrelated commercial intent; the margin comment inaccurately says the balance of the assignment requirements is unchanged.
